jobs.description:
**About BLACK LABEL**

BLACK LABEL is a white-glove procurement, design and technical-support partner for commercial cultivators and extraction labs across North America. As a 100% B2B company, we supply multi-state operators, single-state cultivators and extraction labs with everything from lighting, irrigation, fertigation, airflow, racking, substrates and IPM to extraction equipment and solvents, and we help them design and build out their facilities. Our customers count on us for a VIP experience: expert guidance, precision and follow-through on every order. We are a small, highly committed team that runs on responsiveness, accountability and customer-first thinking.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Commercial Account Manager (CAM) to own and grow a book of commercial accounts. You will own each relationship end to end, including service, retention and account health, and you carry responsibility for growing revenue and gross profit in that book, alongside new business you develop yourself. This is a fully remote, full-time role, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.

This is a sales-led role. It is a strong fit for someone who is consultative, commercially minded and motivated by an uncapped commission, and who still makes every customer feel taken care of. You do not need to be a cultivation or extraction expert on day one. Experience in the industry is a real advantage.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the commercial relationship for every account in your assigned book
* Grow revenue and gross profit within that book through deeper penetration of existing accounts, and develop new commercial accounts, including reactivating dormant ones
* Work through customers' facility requirements, such as expansions, retrofits, environmental control and fertigation performance, and specify the equipment and system design that solves them
* Set customer pricing at your own discretion above the company's gross margin floor, and convert quotes to live orders
* Select which vendors and manufacturers to source a project from, and negotiate cost with them
* Commit the company on lead times and delivery dates to your customers
* Work with our vendor and manufacturer partners on availability and technical support
* Maintain account health through responsiveness, issue resolution and proactive service
* Keep accurate records in Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects and Zoho Desk, and follow company SOPs
* Represent BLACK LABEL as the single point of accountability for your customers

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years in B2B account management, consultative or inside sales, or a similar role where you owned relationships and grew revenue
* A consultative communicator who builds trust easily and is comfortable negotiating on price and cost
* Strong organisation and attention to detail. You can run multiple accounts, quotes and open orders without letting anything slip
* Comfort with business software. Experience with a CRM (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) is a plus
* Self-motivated and dependable in a fully remote environment, with excellent written and verbal communication
* Experience in Controlled Environment Agriculture, horticulture, cannabis, extraction, or a related supply or procurement field is a strong plus

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary of $70,000 per year
* Uncapped commission on the gross profit growth you generate: 15% on the first $70,000 of commissionable gross profit each calendar year, 20% on the next $70,000, and 25% on everything above $140,000. Full new-account gross profit is commissioned from the first dollar
* Group health insurance (medical) through Anthem BlueCross BlueShield, 50% employer-paid individual premium
* 15 paid vacation days and 5 paid sick days per year
* 7 paid company holidays, plus 3 days of bereavement leave
* Fully remote, open to candidates anywhere in the United States

This is a full-time, salaried, exempt position. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. Black Label Supply LLC (dba BLACK LABEL) is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

Experience:

The world’s most sophisticated cyber threats are now AI-powered. It’s time for security awareness to evolve. Legacy security training is broken. jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Location:** US (Remote); preference for candidates on Eastern Time

**Compensation:** $80,000 - $90,000 per year + Stock Options

##### **About Argyle**

Argyle is a fast-growing, remote-first, Series C startup solving a consumer data problem.

For decades, financial service providers and other businesses have collected and verified consumer income, employment, and asset data the same way: by hand or via verification databases. These methods are expensive, time consuming, high friction, and/or unreliable. In turn, experiences like applying for a loan or completing a background check are challenging for service providers and consumers alike.

The solution is Argyle. We’re the leading provider of direct-source, consumer-permissioned income, employment, and asset verifications. We make it fast and easy to gain secure and reliable access to the most complete real-time datasets stored in consumers’ payroll and banking accounts, so service providers can automate verification workflows, save time, reduce risks, lower costs, and build better product experiences.

Named one of America’s Best Startup Employers of 2026 by Forbes, Argyle largely serves the mortgage, government benefits, tenant screening, lending, and background check industries as well as the gig economy.

Founded in 2018, Argyle’s commitment to innovation is backed by investors including Bain Capital Ventures, Checkr, Mastercard, Rockefeller Asset Management and SignalFire.

##### **About the team**

Revenue Operations runs the critical business operations that keep Argyle’s sales motion moving fast, from deal approvals and contracting to billing, commissions, and the CRM. We’re a small team of experienced operators, and we lean heavily on automation and AI tools to do more with less.

This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who wants to learn from an experienced RevOps team and own real processes within a few months. You’ll work daily with account executives, customer success managers, marketing, and finance.

##### **What You’ll Do**

* **Be the first stop for RevOps requests.** Own the request queue for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Handle the routine work yourself, from contract amendments and exports to pricing reviews, SKU setup, and Salesforce cleanup. On every request, engage stakeholders and pressure-test their asks until you land on a solution or a clear escalation path.
* **Own monthly billing preparation.** Run most of the pre-invoice process each month, from custom billing processes, credits tracking, and discrepancies review to finalizing amounts each customer owes.
* **Build controls that scale.** Run recurring checks that signed contracts, billing setup, and platform access line up, and turn repeat requests into documented processes or automation, including AI-assisted workflows.
* **Handle routine deal desk approvals.** Review opportunities in Salesforce for completeness, pricing setup, and contract dates before approval, and resolve setup issues that slow deals down.
* **Manage the customer account lifecycle.** Handle activations, terminations, reinstatements, and access changes, and keep Salesforce and our billing platform in sync.
* **Keep CRM data clean.** Maintain accounts, contacts, ownership, and pipeline hygiene. Monitor the health of the HubSpot–Salesforce sync to ensure a smooth handoff from Marketing to Sales.
* **Support partner and government reporting.** Help prepare monthly and quarterly revenue share reports for channel and integration partners, plus recurring reporting on our government contracts.
* **Co-own sales commissions.** Learn our monthly commission process hands-on, then share ownership of running it each month, from calculating payouts to keeping the process accurate and on time.

##### **What Success Looks Like**

* **Month 1:** You’ve worked through a full billing cycle and the request queue alongside the team, and you’ve shadowed the monthly commissions process.
* **Month 2:** You own most of billing preparation and routine requests on your own, and you’ve used AI tools to automate your first repetitive steps.
* **Month 3:** You own all billing preparation, serve as the front line for the RevOps request queue, and co-own the monthly commission process.
* **Ongoing:** You’re the first response to GTM requests and resolve most of them yourself. You run the monthly pre-invoice process and own key communications between GTM and Finance throughout. With the time AI automation frees up, you spend more of your month on higher-level business analysis.

##### **What We’re Looking For**

* 1–3 years in revenue operations or sales operations, ideally at a B2B SaaS business
* Comfort working in Salesforce day to day, from building reports and updating records in bulk to troubleshooting validation rules
* Experience building reports in Looker or another BI tool, and turning that data into analyses that solve real business problems
* Strong spreadsheet skills, including lookups, pivots, and reconciling data across sources
* A high bar for accuracy and attention to detail, since you’ll work with the contract, billing, and commissions data behind our revenue
* Interest in using AI tools to automate repetitive work
* Clear written communication with internal teams and customers
* **Nice to have:** Salesforce Administrator certification; familiarity with HubSpot; exposure to mortgage, lending, or fintech

##### **Why Argyle?**

* **Remote-first.** Join a globally distributed team.
* **Strong teammates.** Work alongside smart, thoughtful, and ambitious people who genuinely care about delivering best-in-class service.
* **High standards, low ego.** We hold ourselves to a high bar and keep egos out of it.
* **Real ownership.** Everyone owns meaningful work and has the flexibility to work in a way that suits them.
* **Inclusive by design.** We’re intentional about building a team where different backgrounds and perspectives lead to better ideas and stronger collaboration.

jobs.description:

**Location Type**

**Department**
--------------

Strategy & Operations

  

**We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse**
=================================================

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

Every month, millions of eligibility checks, claims, remittances, and claim statuses flow between healthcare providers and payers through our clearinghouse. Our Payer Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the health, growth, and operational efficiency of this system.

To help support and scale this system, we are hiring for our Revenue Cycle Strategy and Operations team. Your mandate is to leverage the data flowing through our clearinghouse to define and track key claims and revenue cycle metrics, eliminate operational toil, improve customer outcomes, enhance our product offering, and uncover payer performance trends across the ecosystem.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Develop and maintain edits:** Translate recurring rejections and errors into clear validation and repair rules through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring.
* **Define and track RCM health metrics:** Develop and maintain metrics such as claim acceptance rates, denial reasons, first-pass resolution rates, payer adjudication times etc. while identifying new measures as payer behavior and customer needs evolve.

* **Analyze payer performance:** Track payer-level performance (claim rejections, delay patterns, ERA discrepancies, eligibility response behavior) to surface trends and identify systemic issues impacting customers.

* **Create actionable reporting:** Build clear, high-signal dashboards and reports that enable Customer Operations, Payer Operations, and Product teams to proactively detect and resolve issues before customers are affected.

* **Drive claims & RCM insights:** Partner with Customer Operations, Sales, and Product to analyze claim flows, denial patterns, payer rules, and reimbursement behaviors that improve troubleshooting and inform product enhancements.

* **Document patterns and requirements:** Create and maintain a knowledge base of payer rules, recurring claim errors, eligibility and status bugs, and remittance behaviors to support faster and more accurate triage.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **You have deep RCM expertise.** You’re experienced in analyzing healthcare claims, claim status, and payer reimbursement data. You know the important metrics and why they matter.
* **You have exceptional analytics and documentation skills:** You treat claims analytics like an engineering discipline: defining clear metrics, validating data quality, building reproducible workflows and organizing complex logic into maintainable structures. You know what it takes to stand up a high-performing claims analytics function.
* **You know the tech stack.** You are an expert in SQL and fluent in modern visualization tools
* **You are excited about using new AI technologies.** You actively use emerging AI tools to improve analysis speed, automate workflows, enhance pattern detection, and expand the scope of what you can investigate.
* **You create and execute your own work.** You are relentlessly curious, and want to become an expert in the product and the overall operation so you can create and prove your own hypotheses. You are not satisfied in a role where someone hands you requirements.
* **You do what it takes to get the job done.** You are resourceful, self-motivating, self-disciplined, and don’t wait to be told what to do. You put in the hours.
* **You move quickly**. We move fast as an organization. You match our pace with urgency, crisp communication, and a willingness to escalate or ask for feedback when needed. You support both internal teams and payer-facing workflows with rapid, thoughtful analysis.
* **You are a “bottom feeder”.** You thrive on the details. No task is too small in order to find success, generate revenue, and improve our costs.

**We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team.** Please note:

* All official communication about roles at Stedi will **only come from an @****stedi.com** **email address**, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.
* If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to **contact us directly at** **careers@stedi.com****.**

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.

*At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.*

Homebridge serves a high risk, high needs, complex-diagnosed population with a combination of domestic, personal, and paramedical homecare functions funded through IHSS. The Case Manager will provide comprehensive individualized case management services to people living with HIV (PLWH) in Alameda County. It is the responsibility of the HIV Case Manager to provide: a wide spectrum of services as a part of a primary care team; help to improve the health and well-being of our primary care patients and promote team functioning; and provide clinically and culturally sensitive outreach services to marginally housed adults in order to engage them in primary care services. Interventions may include crisis intervention, brief behavioral interventions, psychosocial assessments, collaboration with outside service providers, and appropriate internal/external referrals. Strong attention to detail as well as above-average interpersonal and organizational skills are necessary for the position. The position will require travel to sites throughout Alameda County.

This position reports to the HIV Program Manager.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager - Youth Access Point
new_jobs.description:
**About us:** 3rd Street Youth Center & Clinic is a community-based agency providing youth in the Bayview Hunters Point with medical and behavioral health services that encourage them to make decisions that support their health, safety, and development. 3rd Street Youth Center & Clinic also manages a number of successful Transitional Age Youth (TAY) housing stabilization programs and one of the city’s few Youth Access Points.

**Program info:**The Youth Access Point (YAP) Program Manager oversees the operations of 3rd Street Youth Center & Clinic's Youth Access Point and SFSU Rapid Rehousing (RRH) programs.

3rd Street operates one of San Francisco's Youth Access Points at our drop-in sites in Bayview and Hunters Point. The Youth Access Point serves as the frontline to San Francisco's Homelessness Response System, where transitional-age youth (ages 18–24) access Coordinated Entry services. These services include Problem Solving, housing assessments, referrals to emergency and long-term housing programs, and connections to supportive services designed to help young people achieve housing stability.

Our work takes place in a dynamic, high-intensity environment where participant needs, staffing demands, program priorities, and external requirements can shift quickly. The YAP Program Manager must be comfortable navigating complexity, responding to urgent situations, managing competing priorities, and leading a team through the realities of frontline service delivery.

The Youth Access Point Program Manager is responsible for the effective delivery, management, and continuous improvement of housing services for young adults. This position provides direct supervision and oversight of YAP and SFSU RRH staff and operations, including service planning and implementation, program and resource development, contract management, and personnel management, including hiring, coaching, training, and performance evaluation.

This is a highly hands-on management position that requires a balance of strategic leadership, program development, and day-to-day operational involvement. The Program Manager must be prepared to move fluidly between managing program operations, supporting staff through complex situations, responding to participant crises, addressing administrative and compliance demands, and ensuring program goals and deliverables are met.

The YAP and housing landscape is continually evolving, with frequent changes in local policies, funding priorities, eligibility requirements, service models, and system-wide expectations. The Program Manager must be comfortable operating in an environment where procedures and priorities may change frequently and where established processes are not always in place. This position will play an active role in developing new programs, building out service offerings, refining existing models, and translating emerging opportunities and requirements into effective program operations. The successful candidate must be comfortable building while simultaneously managing day-to-day operations.

The role requires a high degree of resilience, sound judgment, adaptability, and emotional intelligence. The successful candidate must be able to remain grounded and solution-oriented under pressure, navigate ambiguity, manage competing demands, and maintain accountability even when resources are limited or circumstances are challenging. This person must be willing to roll up their sleeves, step into operational gaps when necessary, and lead by example.

The Program Manager collects and analyzes outcomes data, prepares management reports, and leads significant program initiatives and improvement efforts. In partnership with the Assistant Director of Housing, the Program Manager represents the agency with funders, government agencies, and community providers. The position requires close collaboration with internal and external partners and may include direct service responsibilities such as case management, care coordination, crisis intervention, and mental health rehabilitation services.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

The following is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Housing Program Manager. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

**Professional Development & Self-Leadership**

* Demonstrates emotional intelligence, self-awareness, and the ability to regulate emotions in high-pressure and emotionally demanding situations.
* Demonstrates resilience and adaptability when navigating organizational changes, staffing challenges, competing priorities, and unexpected operational demands.
* Maintains a solution-oriented approach when faced with challenges, ambiguity, and setbacks; takes initiative rather than waiting for direction.
* Demonstrates the ability to receive feedback, reflect on performance, acknowledge mistakes, and make necessary adjustments.
* Maintains healthy professional boundaries while demonstrating the flexibility and commitment required in frontline community-based work.
* Practices trauma-informed leadership, managing relationships, workload, and organizational change while maintaining personal well-being.
* Participates in supervision meetings, quality improvement activities, agency committees, peer reviews, and trainings.
* Demonstrates cultural responsiveness by working with the whole person in a welcoming, inclusive, respectful manner that embodies cultural humility.
* Seeks continuous professional development and uses performance evaluations and feedback for growth.

**Professional Ethics & Compliance**

* Maintains healthy interpersonal boundaries and adheres to all agency and industry ethical standards, including mandated reporting and participant confidentiality.
* Ensures compliance with all agency and program policies, including Boundary Code of Ethics, Core Competencies, Code of Conduct

**ABOUT LIFEMOVES**

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With 40 programs, LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site-based programs and community outreach.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

LifeMoves | First Step for Families (FSF) provides interim supportive housing in San Mateo to 39 families. During their stay, clients participate in holistic services tailored to each household’s unique needs and goals. Clients receive support to build self-sufficiency and return to housing stability, including but not limited to accommodations, meals, laundry, case management, and therapy. The team supports clients with housing, employment, benefits, physical and behavioral health through case management, workshops, and connection to specialized resources.

The First Step for Families Interim Supportive Housing (ISH) Case Manager (CM) reports to the site Program Director and provides case management, supports daily site operations, maintains a safe and welcoming environment, monitors the site, responds to client needs, and supports client check-ins, group activities, and overall site coordination. The position plays a key role in supporting people moving toward safe, stable housing and greater self-sufficiency. They provide case management services, life skills support, and resource connections and work in partnership with clients to set goals, celebrate progress, and overcome challenges. Using a trauma-informed and strengths-based approach, this position builds trust and respect, making sure clients feel heard, valued, and supported throughout their journey.

Key responsibilities include supporting clients by connecting them to services, building support networks, facilitating groups and activities, advocating for equitable access, and providing crisis intervention when needed. Beyond working directly with clients, this role may help to improve the overall program by sharing ideas, identifying service gaps, and helping strengthen community relationships. This role maintains clear documentation, contributes to program planning and reporting, and models professional, ethical behavior and works closely with their teammates to provide high-quality, coordinated care. Through their efforts, staff empower clients to grow their strengths, reach their goals, and build a better future.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Support and Case Management**

* Develop and maintain individualized case plans focused on housing, employment, benefits, and overall well-being, based on each client’s strengths and goals.
* Support clients with housing searches, employment readiness, benefits enrollment (e.g., General Assistance, CalFresh, CAPI), and skill-building activities such as budgeting and daily living.
* Connect clients to healthcare providers and community resources, and assist with coordination, scheduling, and transportation as needed.
* Maintain accurate and timely client documentation and outcome tracking in HMIS and the agency’s client management system.
* Advocate for client needs and rights when working with partners, landlords, employers, or service agencies; provide mediation and conflict resolution support as needed.
* Provide calm, trauma-informed crisis response and ensure all client services align with ethical standards and agency values.

**Resource Connection and Community Collaboration**

* Build and maintain partnerships with community organizations, public agencies, and system partners (e.g., VA, APS, CPS, Probation) to support clients and improve access to resources.
* Serve as a liaison between LifeMoves and community stakeholders by sharing information, coordinating services, and promoting trauma-informed care practices.

**General Agency Responsibilities**

* Participate in weekly case conferences, monthly trainings, and regular supervision to strengthen skills.
* Fully participate in all required trainings. This includes completing trainings by assigned deadlines, actively engaging during sessions, and applying learnings to daily work.
* Attend continuing education opportunities to grow expertise and uphold agency standards.
* Be available to work occasional evenings and weekends as needed or as schedule describes.
* Perform other duties as assigned to meet program and organizational needs.

**Operations and Site Responsibilities**

* Support daily site operations, including inspections, maintenance coordination, donation management, and general facility upkeep.
* Assist with maintaining clean, safe, and organized living environments.
* Facilitate group sessions or workshops that promote skill development and confidence.

**SHIFT –** Monday-Friday 10:00am-6:30pm

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Educational Requirements:** Associate's Degree in related field preferred; or High School Diploma/GED with 2-5 years of equivalent experience in related field. Related fields may include direct involvement in peer advocacy, community outreach, housing services or roles within the homelessness services field.

* Competitive base salary based on experience
* Compensation and benefits package to be discussed during the hiring process
* Professional development and career advancement opportunities
* Long-term opportunity with an established general contractor
* Opportunity to manage large-scale HCAI/OSHPD healthcare construction projects throughout the Bay Area

For more information, visit www.Synergbiopharma.com

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

Syner-G is seeking a Document Management Project Manager to support capital projects through effective document control, system administration, training, and user adoption activities. This role will serve as a subject matter resource for project documentation processes, document management systems, and Autodesk Forma, ensuring that project teams maintain accurate, compliant, and accessible project records throughout the project lifecycle.

The successful candidate will support capital project teams by managing documentation workflows, facilitating training sessions, leading onboarding activities, conducting Q&A support sessions, and driving adoption of document management best practices. This individual will collaborate with engineering, construction, facilities, and project stakeholders to ensure documentation standards are consistently applied across projects.

This position is internally classified as a Project Manager and will have a primary focus on project management.

**WORK LOCATION:**

Travel to client sites may be required based on project demands and training requirements.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

(This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented or adjusted as necessary.)

* Serve as the primary resource for project document management processes and best practices.
* Manage and maintain capital project documentation throughout project planning, design, construction, commissioning, and closeout phases.
* Support document control activities, including document review workflows, version control, approval routing, retention, and archival processes.
* Administer and support Autodesk Forma and other project information management platforms.
* Develop, maintain, and improve document management procedures, standards, and work instructions.
* Facilitate onboarding sessions for new project team members and stakeholders utilizing document management systems.
* Deliver instructor-led and virtual training sessions related to document management processes, Autodesk Forma, and project documentation requirements.
* Conduct recurring Q&A sessions, office hours, and user support forums to address system and process questions.
* Provide first-level troubleshooting and user support for document management tools and workflows.
* Monitor document compliance and completeness throughout the project lifecycle.
* Coordinate with project managers, engineers, contractors, and external stakeholders to ensure required documentation is submitted, reviewed, and approved in accordance with project standards.
* Support data migration, document uploads, metadata management, and system organization activities.
* Generate document control reports, dashboards, and metrics to track adoption, compliance, and project documentation status.
* Assist with project turnover, ensuring complete and accurate documentation packages are delivered to operations and facilities teams.
* Maintain training materials, user guides, quick-reference documents, and standard operating procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve document management workflows and enhance user experience.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the education, experience, skills, knowledge, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

*Education:*

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Information Management, Business, Education, or a related field preferred.
* Training, change management, or document control certifications are a plus.

*Technical Experience:*

* 3-7+ years of experience in document management, document control, project coordination, project support, or related roles.
* Experience supporting Capital Expenditure (CapEx) projects and associated documentation requirements.
* Experience administering or supporting Autodesk Forma strongly preferred.
* Experience working with document management systems, project collaboration platforms, or Common Data Env

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Project and Program Management**

* Plan and run product programs end to end: define scope, build the work breakdown structure (WBS), and set achievements, commitments, and owners.

* Track progress against baseline, analyze variance, and drive recovery plans when schedule, cost, or scope slips.
* Maintain risk and issue registers with clear owners, mitigation plans, and critical issue paths.
* Run regular program reviews and report status, risks, and decisions to the product team and SIG management.
  

  

**Product Ownership and Leadership**

* Act as the single accountable owner, main point of contact, and critical issue path for assigned products, and communicate the product roadmap to partners and internal Micron customers.
* Lead the matrixed team (design engineering, supply chain, quality, test, and CM partners) and engage the right Domain Experts (SMEs) to resolve technical issues and support program execution.
* Drive multi-functional review of engineering solutions and ensure decisions appropriately balance technical risk, cost, schedule, quality, and manufacturability.
  

  

**Lifecycle, Change, and CM Management**

* Run SIG's PLM process, including phase-gate reviews, work, and readiness criteria, and lead product transfer and ramp to HVM at the selected CM.
* Make sure Engineering Change Notifications (ECNs) and any fit, form, or function changes reach the right internal teams and CMs.
* Support CM work requests, resolve Technical Queries (TQs) with engineering, and manage documentation packages and Requests for Quote (RFQs).
* Run BOM Risk Reviews (BRRs) and own EOL management and alternate-source qualification.
  

  

**ASIC and Silicon Program Management**

* Track silicon-specific achievements and risks, such as tape-out readiness, first-silicon bring-up, package and test development, and yield ramp.
  

  

**Business, Quality, and Continuous Improvement**

* Track product metrics (schedule, cost, quality, yield, timely delivery), drive cost-reduction, and complete Return on Investment analyses to support investment decisions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project or program management experience on hardware, silicon, NPI, or manufacturing programs.
* Demonstrated ability to build work breakdown structures and to develop and manage detailed, resource-loaded schedules in Microsoft Project or similar scheduling software.

* 8+ years in the semiconductor or electronics manufacturing industry, ideally with semiconductor test or burn-in hardware.

* Experience balancing multiple CMs and suppliers across global locations, including Asia.

**Systems and Tools**

Microsoft Project or similar scheduling software; PLM and document control systems (for example Siemens Teamcenter); ERP systems (for example SAP); Tracking tools such as Jira or Smartsheet; and Microsoft 365, including Advanced Excel, Power Point, Teams, and SharePoint. Power BI or Tableau experience.

new_jobs.title: Program Lead, Global Rider Experience
new_jobs.description:
About the Team  
  
The Global Rider team in Community Operations (CommOps) owns the end-to-end support experience for Uber Mobility riders worldwide. Our mission is simple: **fix the upstream causes of rider defects in the product before support is needed, and make resolution fast, fair and seamless when a defect does occur.** Our North Star is the **Rider Defect Rate.**  
  
In 2027, our core focus will be to:  

* Eliminate rider defects, in particular charge riders transparently and accurately for their experience
* Make live chat the default modality following GenAI to enable fast resolution for all customer
* Create clear, trusted outcomes and match customer value and needs to the right level of support

  
About the Role  
  
You will report to the Global Rider Persona Lead. Most team members own a policy area end to end such as cancellations, fare disputes, driver feedback or lost item. **This role is different: you will own a portfolio of transversal programs that cut across those policies.** These are problems no single policy owner can solve alone, and solving them consistently across policies has an outsized effect on rider trust, resolution quality and cost.  
  
You will work with Tech (Customer Obsession and core product teams),CommOps functional teams (GDX, GSO, Central CommOps, PIR, Risk, Finance, CRM, Content, L&D) and regional CommOps POCs to turn several separate policy initiatives into one coherent global program each.  
  
What You'll Do  

* **Lead a portfolio of transversal programs** that cut across rider policies: define the scope, success metrics, governance and roadmap of each, and agree clear decision rights with policy owners, Product and Ops partners. The portfolio is expected to evolve, with new cross-policy topics added as opportunities emerge. Initiatives could include for example:
  + **GenAI resolution (Lumen and Nova):** driving cross-policy improvements to AI-led resolution, for example raising CSAT on Nova FAQ answers, improving intent accuracy and making sure riders are routed to the right resolution path.
  + **Agent enablement in a post-automation world:** shaping how human agents are equipped where automation stops, including: agent tooling, the right agent profile and KPIs (in particular on quality) with our BPO partners.
  + **Driver behavior and top defect creators (Driver Induced Rider Support):** bringing together education, feedback and proactive decisioning efforts aimed at the small group of drivers who generate a large share of defects
  + **Refunds, appeasements and goodwill frameworks:** building a consistent way to recover the rider experience across policies, and monitoring and optimizing spend with Finance and Risk.
* **Find key experience gaps** across policies, along with emerging trends and drivers of customer satisfaction, and use them to shape strategy and roadmap decisions.
* **Own tracking, reporting and performance insights** for your programs (defect rate, resolution rate, iCSAT, spend, agent KPIs) so that prioritization is driven by data.
* **Build the customer intelligence engine** for transversal topics: turn contact signals, sentiment and defect data into sized, prioritized cases that upstream product and ops teams act on.
* **Manage stakeholder alignment** across engineering, data science, product, regional operations, Risk, Finance and other support teams to unblock dependencies and protect execution quality.
* **Partner with the Global Driver team** to keep things fair on both sides and assess how changes affect drivers.

  
Basic Qualifications  

* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in customer experience operations, product operations, strategy or program management at tech or marketplace scale.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in business administration, finance, engineering or a related field.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional programs that span several teams, policies or business lines without direct authority.

  
Preferred Qualifications  

* 8+ years of professional experience in customer experience operations, product operations, strategy or program management at tech or marketplace scale.
* Track record of managing and scaling product-adjacent customer lifecycles, billing or refund operations, or digital/AI resolution workflows.
* Experience designing financial guardrails or compensation and recovery frameworks (refunds, credits, goodwill) that balance customer experience with cost.
* Experience with AI-led customer support, agent operations, workforce or BPO management, or knowledge-base and content strategy.
* Strong skill in using large volumes of customer data, statistical tracking and operational KPIs to influence engineering and business roadmaps.
* Exceptional structured thinking: able to spot common patterns across seemingly separate problems and turn them into scalable frameworks.
* Adaptability and resilience in a matrixed, fast-changing organization, and comfort executing under tight deadlines.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Science
new_jobs.description:
Biohub is the first large-scale initiative bringing frontier AI models, massive compute, and frontier experimental capabilities under one roof. We're building a general-purpose system to accelerate scientific discovery, integrating frontier AI models, biological foundation models, and lab capabilities, with the ultimate goal of curing disease. Our technology powers scientists around the world, translating AI capabilities into tools that accelerate research everywhere.

**The Team**
------------

Biohub is the first large-scale initiative bringing frontier AI models, massive compute, and frontier experimental capabilities under one roof. We're building a general-purpose system to accelerate scientific discovery, integrating frontier AI models, biological foundation models, and lab capabilities, with the ultimate goal of curing disease. Our technology powers scientists around the world, translating AI capabilities into tools that accelerate research everywhere.

The Science Program Management team turns that strategy into coordinated execution by steering our most complex, cross-functional programs. We enable impactful, efficient, and scalable program delivery across the Biohub ecosystem, fostering strategic alignment and organizational connectivity to maximize scientific and technical impact.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Biohub is seeking an experienced Program Manager (PM) to join Science Program Management and own a portfolio of the organization's cross-cutting scientific programs. Each program sits at a different stage of maturity—from strategic planning to proof-of-concept to scaled multi-workstream efforts. The person in this role will be among the first to translate strategic decisions into working programs.

This is ideal for a PM who takes pride in disciplined, transparent execution and brings a builder's mindset to process design, from meeting cadence to cross-team dependency tracking to leadership reporting. You'll report to the Director of Science Program Management and work closely with technical and scientific leads across the organization in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where your contributions directly enable the team's scientific and technical output.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own day-to-day program management for a portfolio of Biohub's highest-priority cross-cutting programs sourced from Biohub's strategic planning processes—partnering closely with the scientific and technical leads who own each program's direction—tailoring your approach to each one's stage of maturity
* Take newly prioritized initiatives from strategy into execution: scope the work, build the plan, and stand up the operating structure
* Serve as the coordinating point for efforts that span multiple teams and functions
* Design and run cross-workstream tracking systems that surface shared dependencies across programs, and operate leadership reporting and escalation paths for decisions and deep-dives that need senior attention
* Partner closely with scientific and technical leads to identify risks and blockers early, and adapt your process as priorities shift
* Establish priorities by evaluating value and risk tradeoffs, and develop metrics for near-term delivery and long-term program success
* Build governance and decision-making frameworks and mentor other project and program managers, contributing to our shared playbook and toolset

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 8+ years of program or project management experience, including substantial time supporting scientific, technical, or research-driven organizations
* Direct experience working in a scientific or technical setting—you are comfortable in the room with researchers and can engage credibly with the substance of the work
* Proven track record of building program structure and process from scratch in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
* Experience managing cross-functional dependencies and stakeholder communication across multiple concurrent workstreams
* Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and shifting priorities, without waiting for a fixed playbook
* Strong written and oral communication skills, including experience translating complex technical or scientific discussions into clear operational plans
* Demonstrated ability to build trust quickly with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners
* Fluency in project management and tracking tools (e.g., Airtable, Notion, Smartsheet or similar) to support planning, dependency tracking, and reporting

**Compensation**
----------------

The Redwood City, CA base pay range for a new hire in this role is $169,000.00 - $232,100.00. New hires are typically hired into the lower portion of the range, enabling employee growth in the range over time. Actual placement in range is based on job-related skills and experience, as evaluated throughout the interview process.

This position may be eligible to participate in our discretionary annual performance bonus program. Bonus eligibility and targets are determined in accordance with our total rewards philosophy and may vary by role.

**Better Together**
-------------------

As we grow, we're excited to strengthen in-person connections and cultivate a collaborative, team-oriented environment. This role is a hybrid position requiring you to be onsite for at least 60% of the working month, approximately 3 days a week, with specific in-office days determined by the team's manager. The exact schedule will be at the hiring manager's discretion and communicated during the interview process.

You will be responsible for helping customers resolve technical issues, testing hardware and software functionality, and working with our team to fix problems and improve our systems.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving technical problems, has strong communication skills, and can patiently guide customers through troubleshooting steps over the phone or in person.

No college degree required. We value practical technical skills, problem-solving abilities, a willingness to learn, and a positive attitude.

**Key Responsibilities**

IT Support & Call Center

- Answer incoming customer support calls and assist users with technical questions and issues.  
- Provide friendly, professional, and effective technical support over the phone, remotely, and in person.  
- Troubleshoot computer, software, hardware, network, and system-related problems.  
- Walk customers through step-by-step solutions to resolve technical difficulties.  
- Diagnose issues, identify root causes, and provide appropriate solutions.  
- Document customer interactions, technical problems, and resolutions in a support ticketing system.  
- Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate team when necessary.

**Hardware / Software Testing & Quality Assurance**

- Test hardware, software applications, new features, and system updates to ensure they work correctly.  
- Identify, reproduce, and document technical issues.  
- Perform manual testing and follow test cases to verify system functionality.  
- Work with developers and technical teams to investigate and resolve reported issues.- Provide feedback and suggestions to improve software performance and user experience.

**Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution**

- Investigate technical issues and determine the best way to resolve them.  
- Assist with hardware and or software installation, configuration, setup, and updates.  
- Help customers troubleshoot login problems, system errors, connectivity issues, and application malfunctions.  
- Identify recurring issues and help develop long-term solutions.  
- Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, support documentation, and frequently asked questions.- Support day-to-day IT operations and help ensure systems run smoothly.

**Qualifications & Skills**

- Basic understanding of computers, software, and common technical issues.  
- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot technical problems.  
- Good verbal and written communication skills.  
- Comfortable speaking with customers over the phone and providing technical assistance.  
- Strong attention to detail and ability to identify hardware software issues.  
- Ability to follow instructions, document problems, and explain solutions clearly.  
- Patient, professional, and customer-service-oriented attitude.  
- Ability to learn new software, tools, and technology quickly.  
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and handling multiple support requests.  
- Willingness to learn IT support procedures.  
- Must have a valid driver's license and be able to drive a car or pickup truck as needed for work-related tasks.  
- Ability to speak Chinese (Mandarin and/or Cantonese) is a plus, but not required.

Previous experience in IT support, help desk, call centers, software, hardware testing, or technical troubleshooting is a plus, but not required.

**We want someone who:**

- Enjoys technology and figuring out how things work.  
- Likes helping people solve problems.  
- Is comfortable answering phone calls and communicating with customers.  
- Can investigate technical issues instead of just reporting them.  
- Pays attention to details when testing software.

Account Manager

Global Fire and Safety is hiring an Account Manager to prepare cost estimates and customer quotes for marine fire suppression, detection, and life-saving equipment. You’ll work from customer requests for quotes (RFQs), parts lists, and supplier catalogs to source equipment, evaluate pricing and lead times, calculate margins, and build proposals in Salesforce.

You’ll work with Sales, Operations, Purchasing, Logistics, Accounting, and field technicians to support customer service, inspections, repairs, and renewals. The team shares responsibility for customer service, and you’ll be accountable for the quotes and assignments you handle. Assignments may shift as workloads and business priorities change.

**What you’ll do**

* Prepare itemized estimates, bills of materials, and proposals for marine equipment, spare parts, and equipment packages.
* Request and compare quotes from manufacturers, distributors, and freight partners. Evaluate availability, lead times, freight costs, delivery commitments, and supplier reliability.
* Apply pricing guidelines, volume discounts, and target margins. Recommend pricing exceptions, alternate suppliers, or revised terms for nonstandard requests.
* Advise leadership on whether to pursue, revise, or decline complex bids based on profitability, supplier risk, and the ability to meet customer commitments. Document the rationale for significant recommendations.
* Prepare proposals with itemized pricing, lead times, payment terms, and exclusions for Sales or Account Management review.
* Track quotes, supplier pricing, and bid results in Salesforce and Uptick. Use supplier performance and bid history to recommend improvements to sourcing and quoting practices.
* Hand off won quotes and supporting vendor documentation to Purchasing, Logistics, and Order Fulfillment.
* Communicate promptly with customers and internal teams, keep quote records accurate, and cross-train to support changing workloads.

**What you’ll bring**

**Required**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Experience in commercial estimating, inside sales quoting, procurement, or industrial equipment supply.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Uptick or comparable quoting or field service software.
* Strong Excel skills, including formulas, lookup functions such as VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, and pricing spreadsheets.
* Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple quote deadlines and communicate clearly with customers, vendors, and internal teams.

**Preferred**

* Two or more years of maritime industry experience.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, logistics, or a related field.
* Familiarity with marine or industrial fire and life safety equipment, such as extinguishers, suppression cylinders and components, alarm components, self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA), life jackets, or life rafts.

**Work environment**

This role primarily involves computer and telephone work in an office setting and may involve occasionally lifting or moving items up to 20 pounds. **Be Part of an Amazing Story**

  

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

  

**Job Overview**

  

The Starbucks Daily Operations Leader directs daily operations of the licensed Starbucks café inside Macy’s, ensuring an efficient, professional, safe, and profitable operation while upholding Starbucks brand standards and Macy’s Foods Division expectations. The Daily Operations Leader works alongside Baristas to deliver quality customer service and expertly crafted beverages, modeling the operational standards that define the Starbucks Experience.

  

The Daily Operations Leader coaches and develops team members, maintains an encouraging and energetic work environment, and partners with leadership to support sales, profitability, and compliance goals. In this role, the Daily Operations Leader positively influences others, strengthens leadership skills, and creates an uplifting experience for both customers and colleagues.

  

*Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found* *here**.*

**Food Safety & Compliance** – Knowledgeable in food safety, sanitation, and regulatory standards, maintaining a clean, safe, and compliant café environment.

  

**Who You Are**

  

* Candidates with a High School diploma or equivalent are encouraged to apply. Retail, food service, or customer service experience preferred.

**Aspire Public Schools NorCal — Senior Analyst for AI, Data & Systems (Enablement)**

**Job Description**

**About Aspire NorCal**

Founded in 1998, Aspire Public Schools has served scholars and communities across California for nearly three decades. With Aspire Los Angeles transitioning into an independent organization, the Bay Area and Central Valley regions are coming together to form Aspire NorCal, operating 22 schools serving approximately 10,000 scholars across Northern California (Oakland, Richmond, East Palo Alto, Sacramento, Stockton, Modesto, and Ceres).

This evolution comes at an important moment for Aspire. Changes in California’s funding, policy, enrollment, and operating environment have created an opportunity to rethink how the organization supports its schools and scholars in its next chapter. The formation of Aspire NorCal creates an opportunity to strengthen support for schools across teams previously organized by geography, improve the consistency and effectiveness of school support, and create clear accountability systems for organizational and scholar outcomes. The new model will require the organization to balance greater coherence across Aspire NorCal with responsiveness to the different communities and contexts of its schools.

Aspire NorCal enters this transition with a long-standing mission focused on post-secondary success and a deep commitment to educational equity, along with decades of institutional knowledge across its schools and teams. Preserving those strengths while building Aspire NorCal as a unified region will be central to the work ahead.

**About the AI, Data & Systems Enablement team**

The Data & Systems team exists to give principals, teachers, and teammates their time back. We are responsible for Aspire NorCal's data and the key software systems that cross departments, and we measure ourselves by the experience of the people we serve: a principal gets a trusted answer in minutes if not seconds, a new hire is entered once, and no one navigates five systems to do one job. We use AI to get there, and we set the policy and training that keep it useful and appropriately safe. The team is made up of an Enablement team that builds the shared foundation, plus pods that each serve a customer group: School Operations & Principals, Academics & Teachers, and People & Resources. Our working principles: go deep with users, one shared foundation, self-serve first, learning is the job, and nobody works alone.

**About the role**

Reporting to the Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Enablement, the Senior Analyst for AI, Data & Systems (Enablement) helps the Enablement team keep the shared foundation running while learning data engineering, platform administration, and AI enablement from experienced teammates. The role supports the team's shared platforms and the warehouse, and grows toward a Lead Analyst role or a data engineering path. This is a growth role, working alongside the Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Engineering as part of the Enablement team.

This posting is for one opening.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle day-to-day administration of the shared platforms (Zendesk, Slack, Monday.com, and other shared productivity tools) under the Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Enablement: user setup, permissions, configuration, and documentation.
* Support the Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Engineering: run and check data-quality tests, keep warehouse and integration documentation current, and watch integration jobs and flag failures.
* Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Lightdash.
* Take requests from the pods and the team, find the root cause rather than only closing the ticket, and propose ways to prevent issues.
* Keep the team's records current: the approved AI tools list, the prompt and training library, and the shared backlog.
* Help onboard new teammates to the team's standups, backlog and documentation standards.
* Take part in the team's learning: pairing, standups, and AI and data-skills practice, with protected learning time.

**How we work**

This is a team of people who are smart, driven, and humble. Learning is part of the job, with time protected for it. We expect everyone to learn out loud, ask for help early, teach what they know, and use AI to give time back to the people we serve. Nobody works alone: you will pair with teammates, document what you learn, and cover for each other.

**Qualifications**

**Mindsets (required)**

* **Intellectual humility:** curious enough to ask the question that shows what you don't know, and secure enough to laugh at yourself.
* **Interest in AI that serves Aspire's mission:** has tried AI tools on real work (at a job, in school, or on your own), and wants to help colleagues use AI to give time back to teachers, principals, and teammates.
* **Teaches, coaches, and keeps learning:** learns from colleagues, customers, and mistakes.
* **Service-minded:** treats principals, teachers, and teammates as customers.

**Experience (required)**

* 2+ years in a data, systems, support, or similar role.
* Comfortable in spreadsheets, and learns new tools quickly.
* Clear written and spoken communication.
* Careful with sensitive data, and follows access and privacy rules.

**Bonus points for**

* SQL or BI-tool experience.
* K-12 or nonprofit experience.
* Experience with a help desk or ticketing tool.
* An AI workflow or automation you built that colleagues still use.

**Compensation and benefits**
-----------------------------

The salary range for this role is $84,564 to $108,556 annually in accordance with our salary schedule policy, commensurate with experience. This full-time, exempt position offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Eligible for Aspire health benefits
* Retirement through CalSTRS or CalPERS, depending on the role's credential requirements, with a 403(b) option
* Paid time off and additional teammate benefits to be determined in accordance with updated employe

new_jobs.title: GTM Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Firmable is the market-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia-Pacific. Our competitive moat is our data: the deepest, most localised company and people dataset in every market we operate in. We've proven the model in ANZ. Now we're scaling it across Southeast Asia and the US.

**US reps can only sell as fast as the systems behind them. This role builds and runs the engine that turns their activity into clean, trusted pipeline.**

**The role**
------------

The **GTM Operations Analyst** owns the tooling, data and processes our US sales team relies on every day, so pipeline is built, tracked and measured properly from day one.

This is not a ticket-taking admin role. You'll own Nooks end to end, shape account allocation, build the reporting US leadership runs on, and work with GTM Engineering to automate away rep busywork.

Reporting to the Head of Growth (Melbourne), with a strong dotted line to the VP Americas. Based in San Francisco.

**About 75% hands-on execution:** tool admin, HubSpot, campaigns, reporting and rep support. **About 25% process improvement:** fixing friction and rolling out new tooling.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **US sales tooling:** own and administer Nooks (configuration, users, integrations, adoption), evaluate new tools and train reps so they stick
* **Campaigns:** build, launch and measure outbound and multi-channel US campaigns with GTM Engineering
* **Account allocation:** keep territory and ownership rules clear, balanced and enforced in our systems
* **HubSpot administration:** support global RevOps on properties, workflows, pipelines, reporting and users for the US team
* **Data integrity:** keep data accurate across systems so pipeline, attribution and performance tracking can be trusted
* **Reporting:** build the dashboards that give the VP Americas and Head of Growth a clear view of US pipeline, activity and conversion
* **Enablement:** Notion documentation, playbooks and process fixes that remove manual work for reps
* **Global alignment:** be the link between the US team and Australia, and support rep onboarding and lifecycle tracking

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

**Must haves**

* **RevOps experience:** around 2 years in RevOps, sales ops or GTM ops, ideally supporting an outbound team at a B2B SaaS company
* **Hands-on HubSpot:** you've built properties, workflows, lists, pipelines and reports, not just used them
* **Sales engagement tool ownership:** you've administered Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, Lemlist or similar
* **Data quality instinct:** you notice when numbers don't add up and fix the process, not just the record
* **Clear communicator:** you translate between sales, marketing and technical teams, and write docs reps actually use
* **Self-directed across time zones:** you prioritise well when the US and global teams both need you
* **You live and breathe AI tools.** You use AI for analysis, automation, documentation and troubleshooting by default. In 2026, this is how one GTM Ops Analyst supports an entire US sales team, and you need to already be doing it.

**Highly valued**

* **HubSpot certifications**
* **Automation tooling:** n8n, Zapier or similar
* **Startup or scaleup background** where you've had to build the standard, not inherit it

**The environment**
-------------------

Firmable runs lean and ships fast: small senior teams, no layers, minimal process. You'll sit in San Francisco with the US sales team, working closely with Growth, GTM Engineering and RevOps in Melbourne.

We are an **AI-native organisation**: AI is our default operating mode, from pipeline and data-quality analysis to automated rep workflows and agentic campaign research. If you're not already working this way, this role isn't right for you.

**Why this role**
-----------------

* **Build the US engine from the ground up:** shape the systems the US sales team runs on
* **Real ownership:** own US tooling with a direct line to the Head of Growth and VP Americas
* **Real career runway:** grow into RevOps lead, GTM systems or US operations leadership; the ceiling is set by output, not tenure

**This role probably isn't for you if**
---------------------------------------

* You want a ticket queue and a clear spec for every request
* Fixing the record feels like enough, even when the process that broke it is still running
* Reps feel like end users to manage rather than customers to serve
* You do your best work inside an established RevOps function with documented systems
* A manager in another time zone and a lot of autonomy sounds more stressful than exciting
* AI is still on your "to learn" list rather than part of how you work every day

**About Priority:**

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** - bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

**About the Role:**

This role owns a multi-project program within one of the product workstreams — Banking and Treasury, Priority Commerce Engine, Merchant and Partner Solutions, or a Core Platform Shared Services domain such as billing or payment rails. You will coordinate several concurrent projects and their interdependencies across engineering, product, and operations, holding one plan and one version of status for the program.

This is an individual contributor role within the Enterprise PMO's Product Launch Delivery tower. It owns how the work ships, not what ships or how it is architected. The role reports to the tower's Delivery Lead and works to the methodology and reporting standards set by PMO Operations and CoE. Customer implementations sit in a separate tower, and product-facing software delivery sits in Product Launch Delivery.

**Responsibilities:**

* Owns delivery of a multi-project program within an assigned product workstream, including schedule, scope integrity, and dependency management across its constituent projects.
* Maintains the program plan, milestones, critical path, and RAID log, and keeps them current enough to be used for decisions rather than for reporting.
* Coordinates cross-functional delivery across engineering, product, quality, and operations to a shared date.
* Produces effort and duration estimates for planned work, and flags feasibility before a date is committed.
* Runs the delivery cadence for the program: planning, standing reviews, dependency checkpoints, and escalation.
* Manages release entry and exit criteria for the program's releases, partnering with Release Coordination on deployment readiness.
* Carries regulatory and control requirements as plan items where the program touches SOC 2 or PCI DSS scope.
* Reports program status through the EPMO Intelligence Portal to the standards set by PMO Operations and CoE.
* Mentors project managers and associate project managers working within the program.
* Contributes patterns and lessons learned to the launch playbook through the quarterly pattern loop.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* The program delivers to its committed dates, and slippage is forecast rather than discovered.
* Dependencies between the program's projects are visible and sequenced, not resolved by escalation.
* Engineering and product partners work from one plan and one version of status.
* Scope changes arrive through a defined route with effort and date impact attached, rather than as verbal commitments.
* Release readiness is evidenced, and post-release defects are the exception.
* Project managers in the program grow measurably against the next level's scope.

**Candidate Requirements:**

**Required**

* 6–8 years in project or program management, including ownership of a multi-project program with interdependencies.
* Experience delivering software or platform work across more than one engineering team.
* Working fluency with integration and release mechanics: environments, dependency sequencing, release criteria, and UAT.
* Demonstrated cross-functional coordination without direct authority.
* Disciplined execution mechanics: an honest critical path, actively used RAID logs, and status reporting leadership can act on.
* Experience in a regulated delivery environment such as SOC 2 or PCI DSS.
* Fluency with both agile and waterfall delivery approaches.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred**

* PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM certification.
* Payments or fintech domain exposure: acquiring, banking and treasury, payables, billing, or payment rails.
* Experience working with an offshore development team.
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Ai tooling.
* Exposure to Lean or Six Sigma methods applied to cycle-time reduction.

**Work Environment & Culture:**

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand - *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

new_jobs.description:
**AI Specialist & Executive Program Lead**
==========================================

**Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE)** | Reports to the [CRO ] | [Location - Remote]

**Salary range:** $108,500 - $147,000, plus variable pay and RSUs.

**How We Got Here**
-------------------

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

* **B2 Overdrive** - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
* **B2 Neo** - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media
* **B2 Cloud Storage** - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in
* **Computer Backup** - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

**The Role**
------------

Multimodal AI data (video, images, audio, and sensor logs) drives the largest new storage needs in AI. It starts with AI builders: physical AI and robotics teams, generative media model companies, and the data providers that feed them. It moves through neoclouds, data platforms, and investors who shape where it lives. Backblaze is the high-performance capacity storage layer for AI. You will put us in front of these builders before the storage decision is made.

This role does two jobs. As the AI Builder Specialist, you own a short list of Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts and pursue them from first executive conversation to a qualified handoff to Sales. As the Executive Program Lead, you design and run the dinners, side events, advocacy sessions, and roundtables that open those doors, and you carry the message that makes executives want to attend.

The role encompasses BD and Corporate Development Lead as the owner of our Executive Outreach Program in phase 1, and Customer-Partner Advisory Leader in phase 2 (within one quarter of start).

This is not an inbound role. If you want a defined territory and a queue of warm leads, it isn't the right fit. If your instinct is to spar with a founder, the CTO, or the investor who can open an account, host the right 14 people for dinner, and follow up with an architecture sketch in 48 hours, keep reading.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

### **Build**

* Run the executive programs. Create and run four to six events a month: executive dinners, co-hosted events with VCs, neoclouds, and NVIDIA, founder meetups, side events at GTC, NAB, CVPR, and IBC, hackathons, peer advocacy sessions, an executive advisory forum, and a CFO roundtable. Partner with the Dev-Rel team on events, especially founder-led ones.
* Own the executive message. Write the 30-second pitch, event content, follow-ups, and partner messaging that Backblaze executives use with AI builders. Work with Brand and Developer Relations so the story is consistent from the stage to the inbox.
* Work the investor channel. Build warm paths through Backblaze's board, investors, and the VCs, PE firms, and GPU lenders behind target accounts.
* Build with Solutions. Bring Solution Architects into account briefings, reference architectures, TCO, and proof-of-concept design. Run most early technical conversations yourself and hand deeper validation to Solutions.
* Map the influencers. Develop relationships with NVIDIA, neoclouds, data platforms, and performance-storage vendors such as Weka, VAST, DDN, and Hammerspace. Work with the Neocloud and Partnerships Leads to turn the strongest into the Phase 2 partner short list.
* Make advocacy repeatable. Align with our CS and Partner teams to sign 3 to 5 design partners and move them up the advocacy ladder: reference, case study, speaker, peer advocate, advisory forum. Work with Customer Success, Sales, and Operations so no customer is over-asked.
* Grow into the next phase. As the program matures, help build the partner motion and log inbound M&A and strategic-investment interest for the CEO, CRO, and CFO.

### **Own**

* Build and score the target list. Own 50 Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts across physical AI, generative AI media, and multimodal data providers. Use AI agents, CRM data, and market signals (funding rounds, GPU contracts, launches, key hires, expiring credits) to rank accounts by actionability every week.
* Map each account. Chart the buying group from head of infrastructure and data to the CEO, CTO, CPO, and CFO, plus the investors and partners who influence storage and compute decisions. Write a one-page brief for each priority account: problem hypothesis, likely architecture, value, and gaps.
